🚀 contrack | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide individuals with a centralized, self-hosted, and privacy-respecting platform for managing, enriching, and actively tracking their personal and professional contact network.
✨ Key Features: • Import contacts from multiple sources (Apple, Google, LinkedIn, Facebook)
📖 Summary: Contrack is a self-hosted, privacy-focused contact management application designed to consolidate, enrich, and track personal and professional contacts. It aims to give users full ownership of their network by importing contacts from various sources, automatically deduplicating them, enriching profiles with notes and web research, and providing tools to maintain relationships.
